acceptance: A data file holds qualification values for all 99 queries, produced by a committed, pinned extraction from the spec source, and every value (not a sample) is verified against that source

Value-level answer parsing has unit tests for normal, NULLS_FIRST and NULLS_LAST answer files, and a parse error fails loudly instead of returning a partial mapping (the t17b branch currently warns and returns partial results, loader.py ~507-543)
The 8 SF=1-empty queries are confirmed to have non-empty answer sets in a test
context: Owner decision D7 (2026-10-03): part 2 (wt-tpcds-t17b, which edits benchbox/core/expected_results/loader.py, a soundness path) waits until #2567 retires the merge queue. #2552 (part 1) merged. 2026-10-03: part 2 is local at 0ee964148, merged with develop. Parse errors raise ValueError naming the file and the result set. 24.ans (fields drift 1-2 columns left of the dashes) now parses through a bounded fallback: it is tried only after the exact cut fails, allows at most 2 characters of drift, and requires exactly one field per column. With the fallback off, only 24.ans fails. All 129 official files parse, and all 99 queries load for both null orders. The Q24 values were checked by eye against the file. 173 expected_results tests pass. Not pushed; a fresh preflight is needed after merging develop again.
description: Commit the specification's qualification parameter values as a data file with a test against the spec text (_sources/tpc-ds/specification/specification_4.0.0.pdf). Extend benchbox/core/expected_results/loader.py, which parses only row counts for TPC-DS (parse_tpcds_answer_file, ~line 66), to parse answer-set values (_sources/tpc-ds/answer_sets/<n>.ans), including the _NULLS_FIRST and _NULLS_LAST variants, following the TPC-H load_tpch_value_digests pattern (~line 224). The 8 queries empty at SF=1 in the gate (8, 24, 25, 29, 37, 41, 54, 58) have non-empty official answer sets (verified), so they are parameter problems, not legitimately empty.
